prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a rugged, rocky trail on the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal. The camera pans slightly to the right, revealing a vast expanse of snow-covered mountains under a clear blue sky, with colorful prayer flags fluttering in the breeze at the edge of the trail. As the viewer progresses, the camera angle shifts downward, focusing on the uneven terrain composed of loose rocks and patches of dry grass. The surrounding landscape features steep, rocky slopes with sparse vegetation, and the distant peaks are partially shrouded in a layer of mist, creating a serene and isolated atmosphere. The sunlight casts sharp shadows, enhancing the textures of the rocks and highlighting the contrast between the dark stones and the white snow. The camera continues to move forward, occasionally panning to capture the expansive view of the mountain range, emphasizing the vastness and tranquility of the natural setting. The scene remains empty, with no other individuals in sight, reinforcing the sense of solitude and immersion in the pristine wilderness. The overall lighting is bright and consistent, indicating a sunny day, and the colors are vivid, with the deep blue of the sky complementing the earthy tones of the rocks and the pristine white of the snow.
